usedFor: WIX holds your site’s contacts and orders, Algodocs receives documents, and “Contact Created” can start “Upload Document”.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Created” in WIX, then “Upload Document” in Algodocs
bestTemplate.why: A new WIX contact triggers an upload of a file given as a URL or Base64.

watchOut: “Upload Document” takes a file as a URL or Base64, so the WIX event has to supply one.
